jei.relicera.info.astral_lens.line_1: Obtained after observing every moon phase with a spyglass.
jei.relicera.info.astral_lens.line_2: This item cannot be obtained again. Please take care of it.
jei.relicera.info.dried_crown.line_1: Low probability appears in shipwreck treasure chests and buried treasure.
jei.relicera.info.dried_crown.line_2: Low probability appears in underwater ruin chests.
jei.relicera.info.dried_crown.line_3: May be found while brushing suspicious blocks in ocean ruins.
jei.relicera.info.ephemeral_bloom.line_1: On new moon nights, Sniffers occasionally dig up this precious flower.
jei.relicera.info.ephemeral_bloom.line_2: High probability appears in stronghold library chests.
jei.relicera.info.extinguished_solar_fur: High probability appears in bastion treasure chests.
Medium probability appears in Nether fortress chests.
Low probability appears in village weaponsmith chests.
jei.relicera.info.feysilver_ingot.line_1: Low probability appears in Overworld loot chests.
jei.relicera.info.forgotten_thread.line_: Tamed cats may occasionally gift this special thread to their owners.
Low probability appears in village chests and ancient city chests.
jei.relicera.info.rotten_tusk.line_2: Hold it, and Piglins will flee from you, as if they saw a Zoglin.
jei.relicera.info.rippleheart_pearl.line: When Axolotls give you Regeneration, they have a low probability of gifting this item.
Feed it to tamed horses, donkeys, mules, wolves, cats, or foxes to strengthen their vitality.
jei.relicera.info.stormscale.line_1: May drop when an Elder Guardian is defeated during a thunderstorm.
jei.relicera.info.warfire_fragment.line_: Drops when an Iron Golem is killed by a raid mob during a raid.
Medium probability appears in woodland mansion chests and jungle temple chests.
Low probability appears in desert pyramid chests.
Very rarely appears in dungeon chests.
